levels.LEVEL_1_SOURCE_ATOM: Exact document evidence preserved in phase-a-client-source-traceability.json
levels.LEVEL_3_PRODUCT_CAPABILITY: Coherent feature/domain groupings in this artifact

capabilities.title: Company identity and issuer control
capabilities.description: Canonical business settings, permissions and immutable issuer evidence.
clientValueDependencies: Approve the physical business address and canonical issuer contacts.
legalReviewDependencies: Company identity must be approved for legal/invoice use.
Issuer wording and document retention need legal approval.
Company settings that appear in legal documents need approved publication behavior.

capabilities.title: Commercial configuration and snapshots
capabilities.description: Versioned delivery, parcel, store, commission, surcharge and payment-method policy.
clientValueDependencies: Resolve Economy/Standard/Scheduled semantics and Express distance versus parcel-size rate interpretation.
Approve final launch limits and rate values without hard-coding them.
Approve final commercial percentages and limits.
Approve surcharge examples and launch policy.
Define deposit, balance, collector, failure and refund semantics for COD partial payment.
legalReviewDependencies: Customer-facing SLA and fee promises require policy approval.

capabilities.title: Modules, taxonomy and store onboarding
capabilities.description: Governed business modules, category hierarchy and catalog boundaries.
clientValueDependencies: Approve final module names and launch scope.

capabilities.title: Nationwide discovery and serviceability
capabilities.description: Selling territory, coverage, distance evidence and checkout serviceability.
clientValueDependencies: Approve operational coverage and optional store-specific restrictions.

capabilities.title: Driver and vehicle compliance
capabilities.description: Identity, documents, approvals, vehicles, eligibility and location evidence.

capabilities.title: Private media and evidence
capabilities.description: Validated, private, owner-scoped and retained KYC/proof/media evidence.
legalReviewDependencies: Retention periods and legal holds require policy approval.

capabilities.title: Payments, COD and cash reconciliation
capabilities.description: Digital payments plus explicit COD/partial-payment custody, settlement and ledger behavior.
clientValueDependencies: Confirm store/module payment policy and limits.
Define partial-payment deposit and balance semantics.

capabilities.title: Claims and consumer remedies
capabilities.description: Claim cases, evidence, investigation, remedies and composable refund execution.
legalReviewDependencies: Remedy policy and statutory rights require legal approval.
Remedy eligibility and consumer-rights wording require legal approval.
Refund deadlines and policy precedence require legal approval.

capabilities.title: Promoter programme and economics
capabilities.description: Programme, ranks, referrals, team graph, qualification, commissions, earnings and surfaces.
clientValueDependencies: Confirm promoter enrollment fee/value and eligible target roles.
Approve one signed rank table, thresholds and registration value.
Approve final percentages and effective dates.

capabilities.title: On-platform advertising and external boundary
capabilities.description: Campaign packages, requests, creative, approval, lifecycle, revenue and external publishing choice.
clientValueDependencies: Supply final advertising prices and package deliverables.
Confirm manual managed marketing versus automatic provider publishing.

capabilities.title: Privacy and compliance engineering
capabilities.description: Notice, acceptance, preferences, rights requests, retention, location, incidents and processors.
legalReviewDependencies: Legal approval of the current policy text and effective date.
Legal mapping must define acceptance trigger and enforceability.
Legal approval of marketing lawful basis and channel scope.
Legal approval of cookie categories and consent behavior.
Legal approval of request identity, exemptions and response timelines.
Approve retention periods, holds and deletion exceptions.
Approve location purpose, customer visibility and retention boundaries.
Legal/compliance approval of incident response and notification obligations.
Legal review of processor roles, cross-border transfer and contracts.
Approve sensitive-data purposes and role/retention matrix.

capabilities.title: Shipping and delivery operations
capabilities.description: Service scope, booking, timing, tracking, POD, exceptions, vendor and driver operations.
clientValueDependencies: Confirm full booking/quote/dispatch versus lead/quote-only depth for moving and specialised services.
Resolve service turnaround conflicts and the Terms 24-hour rule versus current refund policy language.
Approve insurance, declared-value and high-risk item policy.
legalReviewDependencies: Legal approval of delivery/refund deadlines and consumer-facing promises.
Approve responsibility and fee/refund consequences.
Legal approval of exclusions and limitation-of-liability wording.

capabilities.title: Legal document governance
capabilities.description: Versioned publication and controlled reconciliation between policy text and behavior.
legalReviewDependencies: Legal owner approves publication and effective-date transitions.
Resolve policy precedence and obtain legal approval before encoding material deadlines or exclusions.
